note: Launch pads: stand on one and press E to fly the encounter it names. Read by src/systems/flow/game_flow.gd; the owning scene resolves 'town_box' (the pad sits on that box's footprint, at its base) and 'arrive_marker' (where the player lands back on foot, facing the pad) from its own layout data, so no coordinates live here or in code. Labels are here so code stays name-free.

labels.arrive_complete: Back in port. Sector clear, +%d credits
labels.arrive_failed: Back in port. Your fighter limped home.
